instructions.question: What sentiment does this Albanian Facebook comment on the Kosovo public health institute's COVID-19 post express: positive, neutral, or negative?
instructions.rule: Negative needs strong negative emotion toward anyone or anything: horror or despair words (tmerr, mjerim, kjamete, boll keq), insults or curses (including at citizens or the virus), claims the numbers are fake or hidden, anger that measures are pointless, or saying a town failed or lost control. Neutral is calm or playful: questions, requests for data, calculations, speculation, joking banter about towns or staff, tags, condolences, bare orders, and mild worry without a strong emotion word. Positive covers praise, thanks, good news about recoveries or falling cases, blessings, and hopeful encouraging appeals ('we will get through this').

neutral.what: Calm or playful comments: questions, requests for more data, calculations, predictions, speculation, jokes and teasing among friends, tags, condolences, plain advice.
examples: Pse ka Mitrovica Verit nuk po jepni Rezultate hiq !? (Why aren't you giving any results for North Mitrovica!?)
Koka qu sot heret ai i laboratorit (The lab guy got up early today)
Doruntina Ademi ju vushtrria spo e lshoni koronen hiqq (You in Vushtrri won't let go of the corona at all)
Mshelni kafet! (Close the cafés!)
neutral.cues: hahaha, tagged names, pse (why), a ka (is there), duhet (should), hajde ma gjall (come on, livelier), ngushllime (condolences), numbers and calculations
neutral.not_for: Questions or remarks with insults, curses, horror words or claims of fake numbers are negative.

positive.what: Praise, thanks, blessings, recovery wishes, pleasure at good numbers, and encouraging, hopeful appeals to protect each other.
examples: Bravo mitrovica hajde ma gjall te kapum 50shin (Bravo Mitrovica, come on, let's reach 50)

Qëndroni në shtëpi, kjo u shpëton jetën. Ndihmoni vetën dhe gjithë të tjetët. Do e kalojm edhe këtë sfid. (Stay home, it saves lives. Help yourselves and everyone else. We'll get through this challenge too.)
Muriqi Izi Muriqi mir asht sonte (It's good tonight)
Mashallah kofshin me ymer (God bless, may they live long)
positive.cues: bravo, ju lumtë (well done), faleminderit (thank you), lajm i mirë (good news), mir asht (it's good), shendet (health), do e kalojm (we'll get through it), mashallah, perhajr (congratulations/blessings), nice
positive.not_for: Sarcastic praise is negative. Bare orders ('Mshelni kafet!' (Close the cafés!)) and condolences are neutral.

negative.what: Strong negative emotion: horror, despair, disgust, insults, curses, distrust of the numbers, anger at the measures or the government, towns failing.
examples: 15 te vdekur, tmerr. (15 dead, horror.)
kurr ska mu ba mir me ket popull budall (It'll never get better with this stupid people)
IKSHPK mos i fshehni rezultatet Tregoni shifrat e verteta (IKSHPK, don't hide the results, show the real figures)
E hupiii kontrolleen (It lost control)
negative.cues: tmerr (horror), mjerim (misery), kjamete (catastrophe), boll keq (bad enough), budall (stupid), qija nanen (curse), rrene (lies), nuk osht real (not real), fshehni (hide), palidhje (pointless), u lodhum (we're worn out), e hupi kontrollen (lost control), deshtu (failed)
negative.not_for: Calm questions or requests for data, and joking teasing about a town's numbers, are neutral.
